title: ArchitectureRequirement
description: TOGAF-sourced directive archetype — a statement of need that must be satisfied by the architecture. In TOGAF, Requirements span Directives (intent: what must be achieved) and Norms (measurable: how to verify). This schema captures the directive facet — the governance intent. See also RequirementCompliance in norms/ for the measurable facet. Requires GSM unsealing of Directive to be functional. Extends Directive with TOGAF Architecture Requirements vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Requirement (ADM Requirements Management). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Requirements Management).

requirementType.description: Requirement classification. FUNCTIONAL = behavior the system must perform. NON_FUNCTIONAL = quality attribute the system must satisfy. CONSTRAINT = limitation on design freedom. TOGAF mapping: Requirement type (ADM Requirements Management).

priority.description: MoSCoW priority classification. TOGAF mapping: Requirement prioritization (ADM Phase E).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Criteria for verifying requirement satisfaction. TOGAF mapping: Requirement acceptance criteria.
